title: The consumer decision process
caption: High-involvement purchases such as a car follow every step; routine ones such as milk skip most of them. Doubt after buying, cognitive dissonance, can undo a sale in the last step.
alt: Five boxes in order: need recognition, information search, evaluation of alternatives, purchase decision, post-purchase behaviour.
description: Need recognition: noticing a problem or want.
Information search: personal, commercial and online sources.
Evaluation of alternatives on key attributes.
Post-purchase behaviour: satisfaction, reviews or cognitive dissonance.
